gloss: person who sees someone off; well-wisher at a departure

definitions.gloss: person who sees someone off; well-wisher
definitions.explanation: A person who goes to see off a traveler or guest at a station, airport, or port to bid them farewell.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}に{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: The well-wishers gathered at the station.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}には{大勢|おおぜい}の{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}がいた。
examples.english: There were many people seeing them off at the airport.

examples.japanese: {出航|しゅっこう}の{時|とき}、{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}たちが{岸|きし}から{手|て}を{振|ふ}っていた。
examples.english: As the ship set sail, the well-wishers waved from the shore.

notes:
Compound of {見送|みおく}り (seeing off) + {人|にん} (person). Refers to those who come to bid farewell to a departing traveler.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見送|みおく}り{人|にん}が{集|あつ}まる: well-wishers gather
- {大勢|おおぜい}の{見送|みおく}り{人|にん}: a large crowd seeing (someone) off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見送|みおく}り: a send-off — the act itself rather than the person
- {出迎|でむか}え: meeting, welcoming — the opposite, greeting an arrival
